notes: Zones from 'DART October 2026 Service Map - DO NOT ALTER.zip', sent by DART to Atlas Outreach on 2026-11-13 (CIV-1452), zones as of Oct 5, 2026. Geometry used exactly as given (WGS84 in the file). Of its 45 shapes, the 29 whose names match the GoLink zone list on dart.org are drawn, named as dart.org names them (Cypress Waters Freeport = Cypress Waters, East Telecom Expanded = East Telecom, North Central Plano = North Central Plano/Chase Oaks, Passport Park Bear Creek = Passport Park/Bear Creek). Left out, not GoLink zones on that list: City Line Bush Station; Juliette Fowler Community; Galatyn Park Station; Shiloh Road Station; Firewheel CS; Collin County College; Rowlett CS 34004; Collin College Plano; Love Field Airport RP; 12 Th Street Station; VAIL ACCENT S MB; West Dallas Circuit; Rowlett CS 34003; Copy of; Copy of Selected region; Rowlett CS 34003. Hours from each zone's dart.org page (all Weekday and Weekend 5 AM - 12 AM); no holiday hours stated. dart.org's four pilot zones (North Dallas, Plano, Eastern, Rylie/Kleberg) have no shapes in the file and are not drawn.
